name: Dunmere
description: A small farming village where trade has slowed and caution now colors every conversation.

name: The Grey Road Inn
description: A roadside inn where travelers once rested freely, and now linger only long enough to trade rumors.

name: Broken Caravan
description: A half-burned caravan abandoned by the road, with signs of violence that do not fully make sense.

name: Old Forest Path
description: A narrow trail used by hunters and woodcutters, now marked by uneasy traffic.

name: Collapsed Shrine
description: An old roadside shrine disturbed by recent occupation and the sense that something deeper has woken beneath it.

name: Subterranean Hollow
description: A hidden chamber beneath the ruined shrine where the silence itself feels hostile.
